review:
Smokey the raccoon swaps Paris for a Brazilian carnival here, and the game underneath is basically a twin of Le Bandit Hold & Win. Land three or more Coins or Jackpot Markers anywhere, in any combination, and their values pay on top of your line wins.

The real action is in the two Hold & Win rounds from Rainbow and Epic Rainbow symbols, where you collect coins and jackpots as the respins tick down. Rated 3/5, 2,500x max. The RTP comes in versions from 96.27% down to 86.28%, so check the casino's figure. Pick whichever theme you like more.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.28% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
